segments.ja487:1.1: Kharājinā jaṭilā paṅkadantā, dummakkharūpā [dummudharūpā (sī. pī. ka.)] ye mantaṃ jappanti [yeme japanti (sī. pī.), ye’ me jappanti mante (jā.1.6.10)];
segments.ja487:1.3: Kaccinnu te mānusake payoge, idaṃ vidū parimuttā apāyā.
segments.ja487:2.1: Pāpāni kammāni karetha [kareyya (syā.), katvāna (jā.1.6.11)] rāja, bahussuto ce na careyya dhammaṃ;
segments.ja487:2.3: Sahassavedopi na taṃ paṭicca, dukkhā pamucce [pamuñce (syā.)] caraṇaṃ apatvā.
segments.ja487:3.1: Sahassavedopi na taṃ paṭicca, dukkhā pamucce caraṇaṃ apatvā;
segments.ja487:3.3: Maññāmi vedā aphalā bhavanti, sasaṃyamaṃ caraṇaññeva saccaṃ.
segments.ja487:4.1: Na heva vedā aphalā bhavanti, sasaṃyamaṃ caraṇaññeva saccaṃ;
segments.ja487:4.3: Kittiñhi [kittiñca (syā.)] pappoti adhicca vede, santiṃ puṇāti [punoti (sī. aṭṭha.), puṇeti (syā. jā.1.6.13), puneti (pī.)] caraṇena danto.
segments.ja487:5.1: Bhaccā mātā pitā bandhū, yena jāto sayeva so;
segments.ja487:6.1: Kathaṃ bho brāhmaṇo hoti, kathaṃ bhavati kevalī;
segments.ja487:7.1: Niraṃkatvā aggimādāya brāhmaṇo, āpo siñcaṃ yajaṃ usseti yūpaṃ;
segments.ja487:7.3: Evaṃkaro brāhmaṇo hoti khemī, dhamme ṭhitaṃ tena amāpayiṃsu.
segments.ja487:8.1: Na suddhi secanenatthi, nāpi kevalī brāhmaṇo;
segments.ja487:8.3: Na khantī nāpi soraccaṃ, nāpi so parinibbuto.
segments.ja487:9.1: Kathaṃ so [bho (syā. ka.)] brāhmaṇo hoti, kathaṃ bhavati kevalī;
segments.ja487:10.3: Evaṃkaro brāhmaṇo hoti khemī, dhamme ṭhitaṃ tena amāpayiṃsu.
segments.ja487:11.5: Sabbesaṃ sītibhūtānaṃ, atthi seyyotha [seyyova (sī. pī.)] pāpiyo.
segments.ja487:15.3: Na tesaṃ chāyā vatthānaṃ, so rāgo anupajjatha.
segments.ja487:16.3: Te sajātiṃ pamuñcanti [na tesaṃ jātiṃ pucchanti (sī. syā. pī.), na tesaṃ jāti sujjhati (ka.)], dhammamaññāya subbatāti.
